meta.title: Escalation Timeout (Hours): dependency on DoA Threshold Currency does not apply when "Only matters when DoA matrix thresholds trigger escalation" is false (DEP-006)
gaps: Make the condition 'Only matters when DoA matrix thresholds trigger escalation' false.
Leave DoA Threshold Currency unconfigured while configuring Escalation Timeout (Hours).
Exercise Escalation Timeout (Hours) and verify it works without DoA Threshold Currency.
Verify that no amount-based escalation routing impact occurs when DoA currency is misconfigured.

args.need: configure the approval tenant so the escalation-trigger condition is false, leave DoA Threshold Currency unconfigured, configure and exercise Escalation Timeout (Hours), and verify no amount-based escalation routing impact occurs
